mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS membership_id, r.code FROM membership m JOIN identity i ON i.id = m.identity_id JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.membership_id = m.id JOIN role r ON r.id = mr.role_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'active' AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT i.deleted AND NOT r.deleted

SELECT DISTINCT m.id AS membership_id, p.code FROM membership m JOIN membership_role mr ON mr.membership_id = m.id JOIN role r ON r.id = mr.role_id JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 'active' AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT r.deleted AND p.status = 'active' AND NOT p.deleted
